reason_for_revision: The frozen r1 hash-only Birds group allocation failed its preregistered two-sided 19-species coverage check before any formal training or terminal metric was observed. The r1 result is retained as a design failure and is not rearranged in place.

holdout_builder.source_population: only the 322 publicly labeled fold0 records; all 323 fold1 question-mark records remain excluded
holdout_builder.group_rule: remove the terminal underscore plus four decimal digits from each WAV filename stem
holdout_builder.class_target: for each of 19 classes, max(1, min(total_positive-1, round(total_positive*0.25)))
holdout_builder.phase_a: Starting from an empty holdout, repeatedly choose a not-yet-selected group that covers at least one uncovered class and leaves at least one positive for every class in train. Minimize lexicographically: negative newly-covered-class count, normalized target overshoot, normalized target distance, sha256(split_version + NUL + group), group ID.
holdout_builder.phase_b: Until the frozen holdout group count is reached, choose a remaining group that leaves every class represented in train. Minimize lexicographically: normalized target distance, normalized target overshoot, sha256(split_version + NUL + group), group ID.
forbidden_repairs: record-level splitting of a session group

overrides.formal_staging_requirement: The verified formal staging manifest must bind this r2 amendment, its parent r1 file, both feasibility reports, the exact formal_prepare.py implementation hash and the resulting r2 Birds split hashes before any formal training Pod starts.
